{"consolidated_memory":"**Crash Loop Incidents in infra/k8s/deployment.yaml - Two Separate Occasions**

**Occasion 1: [2026-01-11]**
- Problem: Crash loop in deployment; container restarting seconds after start
- Reproduction: Roll out to small node pool
- Trigger: Jobs scheduled across midnight boundary
- Root Cause: Mutable default argument shared across calls
- Fix: Made default empty and built the value per call (PR #5564 on branch fix/crash-loop-1)
- Outcome: Job execution time improved from 7 hours to 43 minutes
- Stack & Checks: YAML with manifest lint and dry run checks in CI

**Occasion 2: [2026-06-13]**
- Problem: Crash loop in deployment; container restarting seconds after start
- Reproduction: Roll out to small node pool
- Trigger: Accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
- Root Cause: Race condition in lazy initialization
- Fix: Guarded initialization with a double-checked lock (PR #7238 on branch fix/crash-loop-2)
- Outcome: Memory usage stabilized at 707 MB instead of climbing past 9 GB
- Stack & Checks: YAML with manifest lint and dry run checks in CI

Note: Same infrastructure component and symptom but distinct root causes, triggers, and fixes resolved in separate PRs five months apart."}
